Spoke to @AJEnglish about the staled US-Iran peace talks, last minute changes in Islamabad, the wide gap between the two sides, and the future of the war.

Video

Why did this war start?
What is it exactly?
When will it end? 

Our conversation with @AndrwPMiller, @AbuJamajem, @dylanotes.

We had a great discussion on the U.S.-Israeli war on Iran and Lebanon with @AndrwPMiller and @AbuJamajem moderated by my good friend and colleague @dylanotes at CIP.

VIDEO: piped.video/1KuqlqeZZkc?si=W_UJ…

Told @MiddleEastEye that millions of Iranians in Iran have deep political, economic, and social grievances against the government, but they don’t support outside powers launching a war that’s killed thousands of civilians and destroyed Iran’s infrastructure.
piped.video/shorts/w510k8Ixp…

Spoke to Australian radio @abcnews about US-Iran peace talks in Pakistan, ongoing conflict in the Strait of Hormuz, Israel’s attacks on Lebanon, and President Trump threatening to renew bombing Iran.
abc.net.au/listen/programs/r…

Told Australian TV @abcnews that Iran and the U.S. both want to end the war but there’s still a wide gap between the two sides. Trump wants a big victory yet Iran won’t surrender. And Tehran wants to make sure if the war ends it doesn’t come back.

Video

I spoke to @NPR about ceasefire and peace talks between Tehran and Washington, tensions in the Strait of Hormuz, and Trump threatening to destroy power plants and bridges, and “blow up the whole country” if Iran doesn’t agree to a deal.

the1a.org/segments/what-the-…

Can Trump & Tehran make peace?  

I spoke to @kaitborsay about war and peace between the U.S. and Iran and the path forward.
open.spotify.com/episode/5gh…

Got mu copy of Ross Harrison’s new book “Decoding Iran’s Foreign Policy” published by @MiddleEastInst.

Looking forward to hosting Ross on our @IranPodcast soon, and a book talk coming up at @busboysandpoets.

Spoke to @SkyNews about ceasefire between the U.S. and Iran, more peace talks in Pakistan, the opening of the Straight of Hormuz, conflict in Lebanon, and the high civilian toll of this war across the Middle East.

Video

I talked to @The_NewArab about how Israel pushed the idea that Iran is a paper tiger, which Trump naively believed, and that the Islamic Republic is weak to the point that Iran could be finished with one final blow.

It has turned out to be completely false for many reasons. Tehran understands itself as being on the defensive in this war while resisting American-Israeli aggression, and has put up a pretty fierce fight.

Great piece by @GiorgioCafiero 
newarab.com/analysis/iran-wa…

Told @BBCWorld that ceasefire in Lebanon is first step towards permanent peace. But a significant gap remains between Tehran and Washington. U.S. pressure on Iran has not produced capitulation. Yet serious, sustained diplomacy can offer a viable path forward.

Video

Trump and Tehran both want the war to end, but each on their own terms.

Trump wants a fast exit. Energy prices are straining the global economy and the U.S., and the war is unpopular at home. But he needs something that looks like a decisive win, ideally, surrender. Iran won’t give him that.
